name: Multi-threaded Advancing Front Isosurface Extraction
definition: The generated surfaces depend on the intrinsic geometry of the implicit function, not the sampling grid, enabling high-quality meshes for high-curvature surfaces.
summary: Multi-threaded Advancing Front Isosurface Extraction is a parallel algorithm that generates high-quality triangular meshes requiring negligible downstream processing, distinguishing itself from faster methods like Marching Cubes by prioritizing mesh fidelity over speed.
